changes: The server console is now quieter, and missions keep showing warnings and errors as before.
Update lyre_bridge to 2.4.0 or newer so routine console logs are hidden by default and can be turned on per script in the lyre_bridge config.lua.
No database or config changes are needed for this update.
!! IMPORTANT !! UPDATE lyre_bridge TO 2.3.0 OR NEWER BEFORE INSTALLING THIS VERSION, and move your HUD hide and show calls into the lyre_bridge config.lua.

!! IMPORTANT !! SQL MIGRATION REQUIRED: back up your database, import the new import.sql, then run the commented INSERT IGNORE statement at its end once before players connect to keep their progress, with the MySQL event scheduler enabled for the weekly and monthly resets.

!! IMPORTANT !! Replace config.lua and the five dlcs config files with the new ones (then re-apply your values), and remove the old lyre_illegalmissions-atm, -cartheft, -gofast, -moneytruck and -murderer resources if you still have them.
Illegal Missions has been fully rebuilt: more reliable missions, a new broker menu, and weekly, monthly and all-time leaderboards.
OneSync is now required and ox_lib is no longer needed by this resource.
!! IMPORTANT !! SQL MIGRATION REQUIRED: import the bundled import.sql into your database before starting the resource.
Adds the missing database table so player reputation and stats now save correctly.
Fix locale collisions between bundled DLCs that broke moneytruck and gofast missions.
Restore the cartheft lockpick minigame and unlock the vehicle on success.
Restore the moneytruck place explosive and grab money minigames.
Requires lyre_bridge 2.1.1 or newer for the new bridge.skillcheck module.
Make sure to update lyre_bridge alongside this resource. The previous release was broken.
New Lyre Scripts structure: install and start lyre_bridge before this resource.
lyre_bridge is open source and is not included in Granted Assets ZIPs; download it here: https://github.com/lyrescripts/lyre_bridge
Illegal Missions now uses a base resource plus DLC mission modules from the new release package.
Keep the base script and enabled DLC modules updated together; do not mix old standalone mission folders with the new DLC structure.
Reconfigure from the new config files instead of copying the old config directly.
Add ps-dispatch compatibility
Add qbcore duty verification
Add wantedlevel option
Add task preview
Add teamMembers argument on alertJob function
